title: Public Claim Fact-Check
description: Fact-check a public/secondary claim: locate the primary source, verify source independence, recompute any quoted number, check population/scope and run adversarial review. Integrity failures (batch timestamps) escalate immediately. Fact-check caps at TENTATIVE.

common_failure_modes.note: Claim traced to a secondary summary, not an independent primary.
Quoted figure or conclusion exceeds what the primary supports.
Identical/batch timestamps presented as proof of reading the source.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed TENTATIVE
source-integrity failure (batch timestamps cannot prove reading)

stop_criteria.condition: primary located, independence verified, number recomputed, obligations satisfied
stop_criteria.note: Tentative ceiling only; may confirm/refute but not over-assert.

stop_criteria.condition: no primary source located after search
adversarial review never run or integrity failure unaddressed
